Campaign

A random theatre of war split into regions held by you and three rival factions. Each turn you attack a region next to yours, which is fought as a normal game; win it and the region is yours. Take a rival’s capital ★ and its whole faction surrenders. Between your battles the rivals fight each other, and sometimes come for you. Hold every region to win; lose your own capital and the campaign is over.
